scoring_justification: Full recomputation of lattice thermal conductivity from DFT and phonon BTE is infeasible; the verifier compares the agent's extracted values to hidden gold derived from the paper's reported results and checks structural monotonicity.

outputs.description: Room-temperature lattice thermal conductivity of RhSi and RhSn computed with PBEsol.

Temperature-dependent lattice thermal conductivity from 100 K to 1000 K for RhSi and RhSn. Verifier checks monotonic decreasing trend and spot-checks values at specific temperatures against hidden reference.

output_contract.notes: Solid-solution and spectral/cumulative thermal conductivity analyses are excluded per task scope. Only pure RhSi and RhSn with PBEsol functional are reproduced.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for lattice thermal conductivity of RhSi and RhSn at 300 K and temperature dependence spot-check points (200,300,500 K) derived from the paper's PBEsol results (Fig. 3).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and Fig. 3 solid lines for PBEsol functional; the reference solve.sh provides the exact values consistent with the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: 300 K values are from paper abstract/conclusion. Temperature-dependent values at 200,300,500 K are estimated from the solid curves in Fig. 3 and recorded in the reference solution; they agree with the paper's reported 300 K values and the monotonic decreasing trend.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported values or directly derived from its published figure; no random fabrication.

steps.description: Compare reported 300 K thermal conductivity for RhSi and RhSn to paper values; each material score is 1.0 if within ±0.5 W/(m·K), linearly decreasing to 0 at ±1.0 W/(m·K).
Verify monotonic decreasing trend for both materials, then spot-check values at 200 K, 300 K, 500 K within ±20% relative tolerance; final score = 0.4 * monotonicity + 0.6 * mean spot accuracy.
